brands.evidence: Monzo’s free UK personal current account can be your main account for both salary and bills.

client_claims.text: Monzo's free UK personal current account can be your main account for salary and bills.
client_claims.note: Facts do not cover use as a main account.
Facts list paid plans but do not say whether they are needed for main-account use.

client_claims.text: You can pay bills by Direct Debit and set up standing orders for fixed payments such as rent.
Monzo's free Current Account Switch Service moves your balance, Direct Debits and standing orders, redirects incoming payments, and closes your old account.
client_claims.note: Switching service is not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: The full switch takes seven working days.
client_claims.note: Switch timing is not covered by the facts.
